cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Technically, Yes
cards.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the holiday watering as complete. The fern you pointed at has been watered.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you do every plant, every day until Sunday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Daily coverage is approved: one teaspoon per plant through Sunday. Every word of your request will be met.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you use a full can on each and empty the saucers afterwards?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The quantities are authorized. I'll empty the saucers on Sunday; you requested daily watering, not daily emptying. Full compliance.
